# Jubilees Chapter 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** God Commands Circumcision; Abraham Renamed; Covenant Sealed

---

**15:1** In the fifth year of the fourth week of this jubilee, in the middle of the third month, Abram held the celebration of the first-fruits of the grain harvest.

**15:2** He brought the fresh offerings to the altar — the first-fruits for the LORD: a heifer, a goat, and a sheep as a burnt offering, along with grain offerings, drink offerings, and frankincense.

**15:3** The LORD appeared to Abram and said: "I am God Almighty. Walk with me. Be blameless."

**15:4** "I will make my covenant with you and multiply you beyond measure."

**15:5** Abram fell on his face. God continued speaking:

**15:6** "My covenant is with you. You are going to be the father of many nations."

**15:7** "From now on your name is not Abram — it is Abraham, because I am making you a father of many nations."

**15:8** "I will make you enormously fruitful. Nations will come from you. Kings will come from you."

**15:9** "I am establishing my covenant with you and with all your descendants throughout every generation — an eternal covenant. I will be God to you and to your descendants."

**15:10** "I will give you and your descendants the land where you now live as a foreigner — all of Canaan — as a permanent inheritance. And I will be their God."

**15:11** Then the LORD said to Abraham: "And you — you must keep my covenant. You and your descendants, in every generation."

**15:12** "Here is what the covenant requires, between me and you and your descendants: every male must be circumcised."

**15:13** "Circumcise the flesh of your foreskin. That will be the mark of the covenant between me and you."

**15:14** "Every male child who is eight days old must be circumcised — whether he was born into your household or bought from a foreigner."

**15:15** "Both the home-born and the purchased must be circumcised. My covenant will be in your flesh as an eternal covenant."

**15:16** "Any uncircumcised male who has not had his foreskin circumcised — that person will be cut off from the community. He has broken my covenant."

**15:17** God said to Abraham: "And your wife Sarai — her name is no longer Sarai. Her name is Sarah."

**15:18** "I will bless her, and I will give you a son through her. She will become the mother of nations. Kings will come from her."

**15:19** Abraham fell on his face and laughed to himself: "Can a hundred-year-old man have a child? Can Sarah — ninety years old — give birth?"

**15:20** Out loud he said to God: "Please, let Ishmael live and have your blessing!"

**15:21** God said: "No — your wife Sarah will bear you a son. Name him Isaac. I will establish my eternal covenant with him and his descendants."

**15:22** "As for Ishmael — I heard you. I will bless him too: he will be fruitful and multiply enormously. He will father twelve princes and become a great nation."

**15:23** "But my covenant will be established with Isaac — the son Sarah will give you at this exact time next year."

**15:24** God said to Abraham: "You — keep my covenant. You and your descendants in every generation."

**15:25** That same day Abraham was circumcised, along with every man in his household — everyone born there and everyone purchased — all circumcised together.

**15:26** The LORD had commanded the angels of the presence and the angels of holiness to be circumcised, keeping the law alongside the angels. These two highest angelic orders had been created this way from the very beginning — and God was pleased that Israel would be like them.

**15:27** So circumcise your sons on the eighth day — this covenant is an eternal decree. It cannot be suspended for a sabbath or a festival.

**15:28** Any male who has not been circumcised on the eighth day does not belong to the covenant family God made with Abraham. He belongs to the children of destruction. There is no mark of belonging to God on him. He is to be removed from the earth — cut off — because he has broken the covenant of the LORD our God.

**15:29** The angels of the presence and the angels of holiness were all created this way from the beginning, and God set them apart to hallow the sabbath before Israel ever existed.

**15:30** He gave no other people or nation the sabbath, or circumcision, or the festivals and months — Israel alone received these things. Israel alone he permitted to eat and drink in the fullness of his blessing.

**15:31** Every nation on earth belongs to God — all of them. But over all the other nations he appointed subordinate spirits to lead those nations away from him.

**15:32** Over Israel he appointed no spirit, no angel to rule them — he himself is their ruler. He will watch over them, protect them, answer for them through his angels and spirits and powers. He will preserve them and bless them so that they are his and he is theirs, forever.

---
*PNEUMA notes: The angelic circumcision doctrine (v.26) — that the two highest angel orders were created already circumcised — is Jubilees' most distinctive theological claim about circumcision. The nation-spirit passage (vv.31-32) is Jubilees' clearest statement of Israel's special covenant status against Deuteronomy 32:8 background.*
